guidance: {"kind": "procedure_guidance_v2", "procedure": "Audit the next action using only supplied public evidence and the execution catalog. First extract the latest request target and operation in its own terms. Separate the target entity from contextual words such as job or work. Then recover any still-active originating request, continuation trigger, ordering revision and cancellation. A continuation can activate an earlier authorization without issuing a new request. Match the target entity and requested operation against the candidate catalog scope AND its prerequisites. Reject a candidate when its scope excludes the requested entity even if contextual words sound similar. Do not infer the task category merely from the word job. Correlate receipts with the exact submitted action and target; partial success does not discharge the remaining obligation. Before recommending termination, check every authorized pending or suspended obligation and its trigger, including conditional final work. Do not interpret missing recent mention as cancellation. In the recommendation use four compact labeled fields: Target (request entity/operation), Authority (origin or continuation evidence), Match (candidate scope and satisfied prerequisite), Action (one recommendation or abstain). In uncertainty name the strongest conflicting evidence or unmet prerequisite; do not invent one. Cite the supporting evidence IDs. Treat memory as fallible: prefer explicit public requests and correlated receipts over summary assertions. Never execute, veto, invent evidence, or use private evaluator information. The actor decides."}
